# Red Mesa Development

> Red Mesa Development is a software studio in Calgary, Alberta. We build custom business websites for a flat $500 CAD with free hosting, integrate AI into products (voice agents, custom-trained models, semantic search, on-premises AI), and develop full-stack applications end to end. Clients own all code, accounts, and infrastructure.

Contact: contact@redmesa.dev · (587) 436-4615 · Calgary, Alberta, Canada

## Services

- [Website Building](https://redmesa.dev/websites/index.md): Custom-designed websites for Calgary businesses. $500 CAD flat for up to 3 pages, mobile responsive, contact form, free hosting on GitHub Pages, full ownership. Add-ons: extra pages, photography, Google Business Profile setup.
- [AI Implementation](https://redmesa.dev/solutions/index.md): AI integration and full-stack development. Voice AI (Vapi, Deepgram), custom-trained models, semantic search with embeddings, and on-premises or air-gapped deployment of open-weight models (Llama, Mistral) on vLLM, TGI, Ollama, or llama.cpp.
- [End-to-End Development](https://redmesa.dev/end-to-end/index.md): Full-stack, AI-focused application development from idea to production. New builds (typically 8–16 weeks), equity partnerships, and support retainers.
